name: vm_native_q2_ref

job.purpose: Native v16 ABI master for NW (RG5/WG3; die netlist main 04fad9220 binds hfd_vms_bank_native_q*, strap masters retired). Same body as strap6: strap5 write tree (payload zeroed at its own pin capture, lv_rep removed), SECDED flip on the D edge. nat2: recipe-3 pin register on every input (+1 edge per input, uniform; native q2 nat1 TT -59.5 = 35 input->reg endpoints, valid pin -> ~281 masking ANDs; reg->reg +60.5), outputs stay RTL registers, EG_WIDE=1 (strap5 q0 TT -114.94: 21/22 violators packet/COLL leaf -> egress pin clones; native q2 gate nat1 placement reg->reg -115.9 at eg_d[10], same egress pattern; equivalence 0 mismatches at RG5/WG2, RG4/WG2, RG5/WG3). Pins: v4 strap grant N/S/W + E face = strap q2 E (0.144 um) minus rq5/rr5 (results/arch/hbm_die_v16/vm_native_bank_grants_0600.json).

pin_regs.reason: outputs excluded: rr*/eg/pr/status/*_done are already RTL output registers (ot_vms_bank_static_strap.sv L135-141, L44-56); inputs get a recipe-3 pin flop because native q2 nat1 06aa9f2f6 failed TT -59.5 on 35 input->reg endpoints (valid pin -> 281 masking ANDs)

floorplan_note: q2 identity2 --cts gate failed GPL-0305 (NaN) twice with the generated 3-macro column (20 um macro-macro channels, 5.4 um halos -> 9.5 um cell rows between arrays; overflow stuck at 0.115 for 12k iterations). Structural: the three arrays (pins only on W/E faces) form one abutted N-S stack (pitch = array height + 0.024 um) centred in the core, so no narrow inter-array channel exists; two ~70 um N/S channels carry the cross traffic.
layer_cap_grant: H-DIE 2210 v4: VM bank strap masters are pin-perimeter bound (270 x 270, ~1,260 b per face): PG moves to M6 so M5 pins need no stripe clearance; parent strap M7 (H-DIE 2210, H-SM proposal)
